gloss: pleasure resort; holiday destination; tourist spot

definitions.gloss: pleasure resort; holiday destination; tourist spot
definitions.explanation: A place where people go for recreation, sightseeing, or leisure, especially during holidays and good weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行楽地|こうらくち}。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{行楽地|こうらくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: Tourist spots get very crowded during consecutive holidays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行楽地|こうらくち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: As autumn tourist destinations, famous spots for fall foliage attract many tourists every year.

notes:
{行楽地|こうらくち} refers to places people visit for recreation and leisure, especially during holidays and pleasant weather.

FORMS:
⟦{行楽|こうらく}→行楽：07788_kouraku⟧ (excursion, outing for pleasure) + {地|ち} (place).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行楽地|こうらくち}: popular tourist destination
- {行楽地|こうらくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧: tourist spots bustling with visitors
- ⟦{行楽|こうらく}→行楽：07788_kouraku⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧: excursion/outing season
- ⟦{行楽|こうらく}→行楽：07788_kouraku⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: tourists/visitors on an outing

USAGE:
Often appears in news reports about holiday travel congestion, especially during Golden Week, ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧ (autumn foliage) season, and cherry blossom season.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧: tourist spot (more general sightseeing focus)
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧: famous place, notable spot
- ⟦リゾート→リゾート：11394_rizooto⟧: resort
